tool.description: Evaluate spreadsheet-style arithmetic formulas to add or transform CSV columns. `formulas` is one or more '<column> = <expression>' (separated by ';' or newlines); expressions reference other columns by header name and support + - * / %, ^, parentheses, and functions (sqrt, abs, min, max, round, etc.). A target naming an existing column replaces it; a new name appends one. Formulas run left-to-right. Non-numeric cells make a referencing formula blank for that row. First row must be a header with identifier-like column names.

data.description: The CSV text (first row is a header).

formulas.description: One or more '<column> = <expression>' formulas, separated by ';' or newlines. Expressions reference other columns by their (identifier-like) header name and support + - * / %, ^, parentheses, and functions like sqrt/abs/min/max/round. A target naming an existing column replaces it; a new name appends a column. Formulas run left-to-right so later ones can use earlier results.

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
